originalTitle: Violent crypto attacks rise as criminals hunt bigger payouts
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in simple terms: there's been a big increase in violent attacks on people who own cryptocurrency, with a 33% rise in the first half of 2026. This means that criminals are using physical force to steal digital money, and it's costing people a lot - $124 million has been lost so far. These attacks are happening all over the world, but a lot of them are happening in France. This matters because it shows that owning cryptocurrency can be risky, not just because of market ups and downs, but also because of physical threats. It's a warning for people who own or are thinking of owning cryptocurrency to be careful and protect themselves.

originalTitle: IDFC First Bank Q1 Results: Profit shoots up 132% YoY to record Rs 1,075 crore; NII jumps 21%
simplifiedContent: IDFC First Bank just announced its quarterly financial results, and it's good news: the bank made a record profit of Rs 1,075 crore. This is a big increase of 132% compared to the same time last year, when the bank made Rs 463 crore. The bank's profit is the money it has left over after paying all its expenses, and a big increase like this is a positive sign. This increase in profit is likely due to the bank's strong performance, and it may be a good sign for investors who own shares of the bank. The bank's strong results could make its shares more attractive to investors.

originalTitle: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 7 stocks rally up to 135% in CY26
simplifiedContent: The Government of Singapore has investments in the Indian stock market, and its portfolio is worth about Rs 1,51,353 crore. Despite the overall portfolio value dropping by 25% in June 2026, some of the stocks it holds have done very well, with one company called Aditya Infotech rising by 137%. However, other stocks like HDFC Bank and Syngene International have not performed as well, which has brought down the overall performance of the portfolio. This means that some of the Government of Singapore's investments in India have been successful, but others have not. The portfolio holds stocks in 39 different listed companies in India.

originalTitle: Gold Edges Up as Traders Weigh Mideast Conflict, Fed Rate Path
simplifiedContent: The price of gold has gone up a little bit. This is happening even though there's a conflict in the Middle East that might cause the Federal Reserve (the organization that controls interest rates in the US) to raise interest rates. The price of gold is staying above $4,000 per ounce, which is an important level. This movement in gold price matters because it shows how investors are reacting to the conflict and potential interest rate changes. The fact that gold is holding its value suggests that investors are still interested in buying it, despite the uncertainty.

originalTitle: Metals Fluctuate as Middle East Escalation Keeps Bulls in Check
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: The prices of metals like copper and aluminum went up and down at the end of the week. This happened because there's a possibility of more conflict in the Middle East, which could cause problems for the global economy. As a result, investors who think prices will go up (called "bulls") are being cautious and not buying as much. This means that metal prices aren't rising as much as they might have otherwise. The uncertainty is keeping prices from going up too quickly.

originalTitle: Big Tech Debt Flood Is Taking Over Risk In Market: Credit Weekly
simplifiedContent: Some of the biggest technology companies are investing heavily in artificial intelligence (AI) and need a lot of money to do so. To get this money, they are selling a large number of bonds, which is affecting the US corporate bond market. This means that these tech companies are borrowing a lot of money by selling bonds to investors. The scale of this borrowing is having a significant impact on the market, and it's changing the way things work. This is important because it shows how much influence big tech companies have on the financial markets.
